# Generated by mods/goods_target/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# The goods lists the player ticks in, and the lookup rebuild that turns those
# ticks into something script can read.
#
# Three things here are not free choices:
#
#   - Item ordinals are literals. A CMM list macro pastes `item = var:x`
#     verbatim and the load dies on it.
#   - Each list is registered at its full height once. CMM's dynamic builder
#     runs only before `cmm_list_initialized_<setting>` is set, and
#     re-registration only ever adds rows.
#   - There are two lists rather than one. CMF initialises list items through an
#     unrolled chain that ends at item 50, so rows past it would be registered
#     and then never initialised -- present in the count, absent from the
#     interface, and silent about it.
#
# Scope: country

bgt_register_construction_list = {

		mod_id = bgt
		setting_id = construction
		field_id = subsidise
		default_value = 0

	# The discount this good should reach, one figure per good rather than one
	# for all of them. Negative is a discount; the engine credits at most -33%.
	cmm_register_list_numeric_field = {
		mod_id = bgt
		setting_id = construction
		field_id = target
		default_value = -33

		max_value = 0

	cmm_set_list_field_conditional_format = { mod_id = bgt setting_id = construction field_id = target }

# Turn the ticks into variable lists and maps a trigger can ask about. Called on
# registration and from each list's _on_changed scripted GUI, which is the only
# route a click on a list takes into script -- CMM's auto-apply covers bool,
# dropdown, numeric, slider and button settings, and not lists.
#
# The two lists keep their own results rather than being merged, because
# `cmm_build_list_bool_list` clears the list it writes into: a merge would leave
# only whichever ran last. Anything reading these has to read both.
# Scope: country
bgt_register_lists = {
	bgt_register_construction_list = yes
	bgt_register_other_list = yes
}

bgt_rebuild_lookups = {
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bgt__construction }
		cmm_build_list_ordered_values = { setting = bgt__construction list_name = bgt_construction_goods }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bgt__construction field_slot = 1 list_name = bgt_construction_build }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bgt__construction field_slot = 2 list_name = bgt_construction_subsidise }
		cmm_build_list_field_map = { setting = bgt__construction field_slot = 3 map_name = bgt_construction_target multiply = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		# Registration may not have completed yet on the first pass.
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_bgt__other }
		cmm_build_list_ordered_values = { setting = bgt__other list_name = bgt_other_goods }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bgt__other field_slot = 1 list_name = bgt_other_build }
		cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bgt__other field_slot = 2 list_name = bgt_other_subsidise }
		cmm_build_list_field_map = { setting = bgt__other field_slot = 3 map_name = bgt_other_target multiply = 1 }
	}
}
